name: Enraged Rowan the Whispering
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-99: Under the Eye of the Mantis

items.name: Dagger
items.description: This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

items.name: Serpent Dagger
items.description:
The serrated blade of this +1 striking dagger has a greenish tinge, and the hilt is sculpted to look like the head of a serpent about to strike.

When you critically succeed at an attack roll with the serpent dagger, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Sickened]{Sickened 1} unless it succeeds at a @Check[fortitude|dc:19] save. This is a poison effect.

In addition, you can activate the dagger to poison a creature with a more potent poison.

Activate—Drip Poison F (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You damage a creature with the serpent dagger

Effect You poison the creature you hit with dagger venom.

Dagger Venom (poison)

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d8[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 1}

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

defensiveAbilities.name: Tether Pull
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Rowan has thrown her Serpent Dagger at a target

Frequency once per turn

Effect After the attack's result is resolved, Rowan yanks on the cord attached to the weapon's hilt, returning it to her hand. If she throws the weapon to a distance of 20 feet or beyond, this ability becomes 1-action and gains the manipulate trait.

offensiveAbilities.name: Flash Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Rowan's strikes deal 1d6 extra damage to creatures who are Off-Guard to her, or who are within reach of at least one of her allies.

offensiveAbilities.name: Mirror Step
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Rowan is within 30 feet of one of the circular mirrors in the southern two rooms of the laboratory

Effect Rowan uses her connection to the aiudara fragments to translocate. She Strides once into one of the circular mirrors, teleporting to any other such mirror of her choice. When she does this, she leaves behind a mirrored image of herself until the start of her next turn. This image acts as an ally for all purposes, but has an AC of 0, 1 HP, and cannot take actions.
